name: Crispy Slow Cooker Pork Carnitas

fit.fit_ruling: FIT on numbers, but killed as DUPE

evidence: Same dish as the catalog's slow-cooker-pork-carnitas-bowl (Pork Carnitas Burrito Bowl): identical Mexican carnitas protein prep - slow-cooked pork shoulder with orange juice, cumin, oregano and jalapeno then shredded/crisped - matching on protein, sauce/flavor family, and method (3 of 4); the only difference is the serving base (no rice vs cilantro-lime rice), a starch swap that does not make carnitas a different dinner, so this is the identical seasoned pork under a low-carb framing.
cross_protein_note: Not selected, but if a twin surfaces this concept could collide with a beef barbacoa / Mexican shredded-beef or a chicken carnitas-style dish in other pools.
confidence: high on nutrition fit; high on dedup - carnitas concept is already in catalog
